name: Writer's Hoard
purpose: Draft, edit and query manuscripts, plus interactive-fiction world state, continuity, sessions, dice, threads and clocks in Writer.

check.en: Reread the chapter, world date and character details, or reopen the exported report and compare citations with its sources.
check.es: Relee el capítulo, la fecha del mundo y los detalles del personaje, o abre el informe exportado y coteja las citas con sus fuentes.

check.en: File it with wh_import_evidence (coaseReportId) so each claim keeps its quote; reopen the report and check that cited sources, links and tables survived export.
check.es: Archívalo con wh_import_evidence (coaseReportId) para que cada afirmación conserve su cita; abre el informe y comprueba que la exportación conserva las citas, los enlaces y las tablas.

check.en: Call wh_get_research_evidence and check that every claim kept its source and verbatim quote; cite one with insertCitation and reread the paragraph.
check.es: Llama a wh_get_research_evidence y comprueba que cada afirmación conserva su fuente y su cita literal; cita una con insertCitation y relee el párrafo.

x-family.note: A desktop app: the port answers only while the AI bridge is switched on in Settings. The token lives under the user's profile, not in the repository folder. DATA_DIR is the app's own archive folder (the ZIP snapshots it rotates itself): a consistent copy of every project, small, never the live IndexedDB store or the media cache.

fiction.data: in-place selectable directory; no automatic migration

notes: The Hub starts the repository's desktop launcher. Set up the source checkout first. Turn on the AI bridge in Settings when you want agents to connect. The source launcher and MCP adapter use the repository build.
